page: Microsoft Azure E128as_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by 4th Gen AMD EPYC 9V45 processors operating at up to 4.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 128 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 64 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. It features 1024 GB of total system memory, maintaining an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 8.0 GB of RAM allocated per virtual core. The underlying processor includes AVX-512 extensions with support for VNNI and bfloat16, alongside hardware cryptographic instruction support including VAES and SHA-NI.

Benchmark evaluations position the E128as_v7 in the top tier for raw compute and memory throughput. The instance registered a multi-core score of 234061.17 in stress-ng and 28718.0 in Geekbench multi-core testing. Memory subsystem tests show high throughput, recording 376.87 GB/sec in 256 MB block uncached reads and 199.07 GB/sec in sequential writes. In in-memory data store workloads, the server achieved 177.27 million operations per second during Redis SET benchmarks, while also sustaining robust throughput in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation.

Because the E128as_v7 does not include bundled local instance storage, all disk operations require attached remote storage such as Azure Premium SSDs. Furthermore, the instance lacks discrete GPUs, meaning matrix-heavy machine learning tasks rely entirely on CPU execution via AVX-512. For CPU-bound inference, the machine achieved 324.38 tokens/sec prompt processing on 7B parameter models, though large models run at modest throughput compared to dedicated accelerators. From an infrastructure cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of memory and processor cores reduces node count overhead for large-scale clustered workloads.

The E128as_v7 is designed for large in-memory transactional and analytical databases, enterprise memory caches, distributed data pipelines, complex simulations, and high-concurrency enterprise applications that depend on vast memory capacity alongside multi-threaded x86 compute.
description: Microsoft Azure E128as_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores on AMD EPYC 9V45 processors clocked up to 4.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance incorporates 1024 GB of RAM, offering an 8 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside AVX-512 instruction support with VNNI and bfloat16. There is no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent workloads, and no discrete GPU acceleration. Benchmark results confirm top-tier multi-threaded processing and memory bandwidth, reaching 376.87 GB/sec in large uncached reads and sustaining over 177 million Redis SET operations per second. The instance provides strong resource density for enterprise memory footprints, making it suitable for in-memory databases, large Redis clusters, high-throughput ETL data engines, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
